mappings.note: What a bank account does for a person, and whether everyone should have one. CG-SST4 at goal level because this frame has no outcome for money, banking or saving - its C-SST4.2 LOs are a local market visit and a State office report; LO-152 for the inclusion argument in the second half.
Compound interest weighed from the saver's and the borrower's side. Goal-level CG-SST4; the frame has no finance outcome, which is the gap being worked around throughout this chapter.

How financial infrastructure moves money between households and businesses, and what government can do. Goal-level CG-SST4, which names market and government together. (Empty answer on this row; see report.)
Whether two people could lend to each other without a bank, and what would go wrong. The case for the institution itself, goal-level CG-SST4.
How a bank tracks deposits and withdrawals, answered through the passbook. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Reading debit and credit entries in a passbook and why records matter. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Why companies issue shares and why people buy them. Goal-level CG-SST4; LO-160 is rejected because a stock market is not a local market visited in person.
Financial infrastructure defined and set beside physical infrastructure. CG-SST4 for the financial institutions, C-SST4.2 at competency level for the public works it funds.

This row's stem is a question and its answer run together; the scored content is the fieldwork its answer supplies - asking a family member and a neighbour how they save, how they pay, and whether they have met fraud. CG-SST4 for saving and payment, LO-154 for reading it in one's own locality. (Merged stem; see report.)

A digital-banking safety poster with the cybercrime portal and the 1930 helpline. Goal-level CG-SST4 for the financial institutions and the protections around them. (Empty answer on this row; see report.)
Filling out cheques for utility bills under supervision. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Filling a cash withdrawal slip for 10,000 rupees. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Why a fixed deposit pays more than a savings account. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Sahil's 10,000 rupees at 12 percent compounded over three years. Goal-level CG-SST4; the arithmetic is the vehicle, the concept is compounding.
How the stock market gathers individual savings and what companies gain by issuing shares. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Balancing the convenience of digital payment against cyber fraud. Goal-level CG-SST4; LO-159 is rejected because no media or advertising role is at issue.
Reading a photograph of a bank and asking family about their visits. Goal-level CG-SST4 for the institution being observed.
Why a bank beats a cupboard - safety plus interest that compounds. Goal-level CG-SST4.

This row's stem is a question and its answer run together; the scored content is what its own answer resolves - financial infrastructure as the network of banks, payment systems and stock markets. Goal-level CG-SST4. (Merged stem; see report.)
Why physical infrastructure cannot be built without the financial kind. CG-SST4 for the capital, C-SST4.2 for the roads and railways it pays for.
A bank defined as an institution taking deposits and lending them on. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Savings account against fixed deposit - flexible withdrawal versus a locked term. Goal-level CG-SST4.
The RBI established in 1935. Goal-level CG-SST4 for a governing financial institution; CG-SST2 is not added because the date is recalled as institutional fact, not as history.

How commercial banks earn - the spread between deposit and lending rates. Goal-level CG-SST4. (The stored key letter, the quoted option and the explanation on this row disagree with one another; see report.)
Direct transfer of wages and scholarships cutting out middlemen. CG-SST4 for the banking system, LO-152 because the point is that entitlements reach everyone intact.
The RBI's benchmark rate as the base for lending to commercial banks. Goal-level CG-SST4.

Yaksha and yakshi at the RBI's door as guardians of Kubera's treasure. CG-SST2 for the mythological reference being read, CG-SST4 for the institution it comments on; LO-150 is rejected because no religious movement is explained.
NABARD as the institution funding agriculture and village infrastructure. Goal-level CG-SST4. (The stored key letter, the quoted option and the explanation on this row all disagree; see report.)
POS machines at a shop counter taking a card and a PIN. LO-160 is a genuine fit - how a retail transaction works in a shop - with CG-SST4 for the banking rails behind it.
'Credit' in a passbook as money coming in. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana of 2014 giving zero-balance accounts. CG-SST4 for the government scheme, LO-152 because financial inclusion is its purpose.
The RBI as banker to banks and supervisor of the system. Goal-level CG-SST4.
A cheque as the paper instruction to pay from one's account. Goal-level CG-SST4.
PIN as Personal Identification Number. Goal-level CG-SST4 for the mechanics of banking.
NPCI launching UPI in 2016. Goal-level CG-SST4 for a payments institution.
The Bombay Stock Exchange founded in 1875. Goal-level CG-SST4 for a market institution.
Most of the 50 crore Jan Dhan accounts opened by women. LO-158 is the frame's women outcome and the scheme is read here as redress for their exclusion from finance; CG-SST4 for the scheme itself.
A restaurant owner issuing shares to friends for capital, in exchange for part-ownership and a share of profit. Goal-level CG-SST4.
A crash as many companies' share prices falling sharply together, not one firm's bad quarter. Goal-level CG-SST4.
The NPCI network verifying the UPI PIN before authorising a transfer. Goal-level CG-SST4 for the payments institution and its safeguards.
The RBI transferred to the Government of India in 1949. Goal-level CG-SST4 for the central bank's status.
The Kodumbalur copper plates showing temples lending to artisans and local bodies at interest. CG-SST2 for the inscription as a historical source, CG-SST4 for the banking function it reveals.
Retail markets selling food and books against stock exchanges trading securities. LO-160 for the retail market side, CG-SST4 for the financial market it is contrasted with.
Nepal as the first country to adopt UPI, in 2022. Goal-level CG-SST4 for the payments system's reach.
An economic shock illustrated by a devastating earthquake disrupting the whole economy. CG-SST4 for the economic concept, LO-144 because the example that carries it is a natural disaster.
Scanning a QR code on a vegetable seller's cart to pay instantly. LO-160 for the working of a local market, CG-SST4 for the UPI rails behind the sale.
The passbook as the bank's record of receipts and payments. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Kisan Vikas Patra as a post office savings scheme. Goal-level CG-SST4 for a savings institution reaching remote areas.
A share as a unit of ownership in a company. Goal-level CG-SST4. (The options on this row run into text from another question and the stored answer is NABARD's, not a share's; see report.)
Putting surplus salary into a bank identified as making a deposit. Goal-level CG-SST4.
The current account as the businesses-and-traders account with frequent transactions and no interest. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Compounding as interest on interest. Goal-level CG-SST4.
A QR code scanned at a vendor's stall to start a UPI payment. LO-160 for the market transaction, CG-SST4 for the payment system.
The Ambalappuzha chessboard story as an illustration of exponential growth through compounding. CG-SST4 for the financial concept, CG-SST2 because the vehicle is a traditional tale.

The RBI issuing currency and setting benchmark rates, against the false claim that it opens Jan Dhan accounts for farmers itself. Goal-level CG-SST4 for the division of roles between central and commercial banks. (Stem survives only as its last line; see report.)
Financial infrastructure named. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Money placed in an account called a deposit. Goal-level CG-SST4.
The current account as the business account. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Interest on previous interest called compounding. Goal-level CG-SST4.
Taking money out of an account called a debit. Goal-level CG-SST4.
